**What it's for:** A seven-day remediation planner for nursing study. Takes topics you missed (with your own notes) and generates a balanced study schedule that reinforces topics via practice sessions framed around PN (practical nurse) scope of practice — monitoring, reporting, reinforcing teaching, following care plans.

**Key rules anyone must follow:**

- All content must be PN scope of practice (reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan)
- No gamification/streaks/leaderboards
- Keep 7 as the default number of days
- Balance days so no day has more than two topics from the same client need
- Don't share publicly — for personal use
